field.name: default_note
field.p: Review the patient's preferred contact method and preview the registration email. Share the actual document or send a personal request through Sign when needed; this introductory email does not create or send a signature request.

record.field: Follow up on the patient's quotation

field.name: default_note
field.p: Review the quotation, any reply and the agreed contact method before following up. Preview the email and quotation portal link. Complete this activity if the proposal is already accepted, cancelled or otherwise resolved, and update the linked opportunity's next step.

record.field: Check in with the patient after the visit

field.name: default_note
field.p: Confirm that the visit took place, check the preferred contact method and use the timing agreed with the practitioner. Preview this reception check-in before sending and route questions about care to the responsible practitioner.

record.field: Follow up on an outstanding patient invoice

field.name: default_note
field.p: Review the posted customer invoice, remaining balance, due date and recent collections before contacting the patient. Preview the reminder, which uses the current remaining balance. Complete the activity if the invoice has been paid, reversed or cancelled. The activity does not post an invoice or collect payment.
